The sentence is accurate. 'Binds' means the ceiling changes the value: with D 4 and maxDepth 3, one seed gives 2 x 4 x (1 + 2) = 24, which min(24, ...) leaves unchanged, and two seeds give 2 x 4 x 4 = 32, which the ceiling cuts to 24. So the ceiling binds from two seeds on, as written; the lane's arithmetic (24 at one seed) agrees.
